messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: HTTP 5xx rate spike detected against inference-gateway-us-west2. 5m error-rate = 13.2% (threshold 3%). link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc123/inference-gateway?orgId=1
jenna_sre: acked. i'm on it — looking at the ingress and replica counts.
mikhail_oncall: thanks @jenna_sre. pinging pd, leaving note for customer comms. any region-wide deploys?
jenna_sre: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. checking k8s events and HPA. running: `kubectl -n inference get deploy inference-gateway -o wide`
tim_infra: seeing elevated connection resets from edge LB -> backend pool around 6387654200-6387654300 in logs. could be upstream auth thrash to redis kv cache. tail: ```2026-03-15T03:05:21Z inference-gw ERROR backend call failed status=502 conn_reset backend=kv-store-usw2```
maria_support: customers reported increased latency + 5xx on streaming endpoints. possible impact to some PLG users (high QPS). i've posted initial note to status-page draft.
sara_ops: what's scope? single AZ or multi-AZ?
jenna_sre: metrics show spike concentrated in us-west2-a and us-west2-b, less in us-west2-c. suggests a partial infrastructure issue, maybe a subset of nodes. checking node CPU/memory and socket errors.
mikhail_oncall: action plan: 1) scale up gateway replicas by 30% 2) fail traffic from unhealthy node pool via LB weight 3) warm fallback model variant. who can run the scale?
tim_infra: i'll patch the LB weights — will shift ~40% of traffic to eu-west for affected routes as temporary mitigation. running command now: `lbctl set-weight inference-gw-usw2-pool 0.6`
jenna_sre: scaling: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=26` (was 20) — scaling event triggered. watching pods come up.
pagerbot: pagerduty: Trigger #PD98765 created by alerting-rule `gateway_5xx_rate_high`. Current status: acknowledged by mikhail_oncall. Escalation paused. link: https://pd.example/alerts/PD98765
mikhail_oncall: acked in PD. assigning to jenna for triage; tim for infra reroute; maria handles comms. start a postmortem stub once we stabilize.
maria_support: posted status update: "We're investigating elevated error rates in US-WEST2 affecting inference responses. Engineers are applying mitigations — more info soon." will update every 15 min. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jenna_sre: new pods are coming up but healthchecks show backend 502s on a subset. dumping kube describe on failing pod: ```Events: Warning Unhealthy Liveness probe failed: HTTPProbe failed with statuscode=502```
sara_ops: can we isolate by cordoning nodes with high `connreset` rates?
tim_infra: cordon/evict in progress for 3 problematic nodes. `kubectl cordon node-usw2-7 && drain node-usw2-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
jenna_sre: after draining node-usw2-7, 5xx rate dipped to 6.4% — still above threshold but improving.
mikhail_oncall: good. continue reroute + evictions. set customer-impact tag: "partial degradation - US-WEST2" and escalate to SEs for high-value customers if they reach out.
maria_support: updated status note with next ETA for followup.
pagerbot: note: automated runbook suggestion: run `rundown gateway-kv-metrics --window=10m` — flagged by `runbooks/ingress-502` with tie to kv-timeouts.
jenna_sre: running the rundown now; preliminary shows a burst of redis auth failures (401) from 03:04-03:08 which correlates with node restarts in node-usw2-7 pool. investigating why auth tokens expired.
tim_infra: i see a control-plane job rotated a cert for kv-auth at 03:02 — rolling restart maybe didn't finish on all nodes. leaning toward cert rollout race.
mikhail_oncall: decision: rollback control-plane kv-auth rotation to previous cert and restart kv auth sidecars gracefully. tim, coordinate with infra. jenna, confirm gateway health after rollback.
tim_infra: initiating rollback to kv-auth:v20260314. commands: `kubectl -n infra set image secret-sidecar kv-auth=kv-auth:v20260314 && kubectl rollout restart ds/kv-auth-sidecar -n infra`
jenna_sre: post-rollback health: 5xx rate now 1.2% in us-west2, latency normalized. marking incident as mitigated.
maria_support: pushing update to status: "Mitigated. Root cause under investigation: control-plane cert rotation caused transient auth failures on KV sidecars impacting a subset of gateway nodes."
msara_ops: handing off to postmortem owners: jenna and tim. I'll schedule a handoff call for 04:00 UTC for follow-through. :white_check_mark:

Note: timeline above is chronological messages from pagerbot + people; next steps: create postmortem, verify canary rotation path, add pre-rollout gating for kv-auth certs."
